text.formatted: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.
text.plain: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

text.formatted: The bulette spends 5 feet of movement to jump to a space within 15 feet that contains one or more Large or smaller creatures. _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 15, each creature in the bulette's destination space. _Failure:_ 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. _Success:_ Half damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the bulette.
